claim_scope: One-molecule, polar-only numerical capability probe of APBS SPL4 forces. It does not use hydration labels, does not benchmark solvation accuracy, and does not promote a production provider.

decision.nonpolar_force_status: not assessed here; APBS APOLAR is audited separately
decision.reason: The molecular-surface endpoint is rejected by APBS itself. The SPL4 substitute fails the frozen numerical checks, and its mbondi2 radii have not been reparameterized for a spline surface. Independent accuracy, speed, and multi-geometry validation would still be required after those failures.

method.grid_center_policy: gcent mol 1 on every APBS call

molecular_surface_force_request.rejection_message: Forces *must* be calculated with spline-based surfaces!

numerical_gate.scope: Numerical derivative and grid-behavior gate only; passing would not establish FreeSolv accuracy or useful throughput.

route1_contract.fixed_charge_source: AM1-BCC charges frozen in the MOL2
route1_contract.name: Additive fixed-charge PB/GB implicit solvation
